recycled_content.source_quote: 100 % of the material consists of recycled Prusament PETG materials, so every batch has a different color. … Waste produced during our in-house production of Prusament PETG is recycled and used as a base for Prusament PETG Recycled.

carbon_footprints.source_quote: whereas 1 kg of Prusament PETG Recycled comes with only 2.55 kg CO 2 emissions thanks to leaving out the transportation and production of new granulate
carbon_footprints.notes: LCA by Ing. Marie Tichá in SimaPro 9.3.0.2, covering stages 'to packing the filament into the box'. The blog says a detailed LCA overview would be prepared for download, but it is not confirmed as published. No allocation method is named for the recycled input.
